raw_answer_text:
```
figdown 0.1 topology
title "East campus site map"

group siteA "Site A campus"
node a1 "Site A router" in=siteA
node a2 "Site A switch" in=siteA
node relay "Relay node"
node siteb "Site B router"

edge a1 -> a2
edge relay -> siteb
edge a2 -> relay

pin siteA at=(0,0)
pin a1 at=(0,0) width=120 height=50
pin a2 at=(0,80) width=120 height=50
pin relay at=(200,30) width=80 height=30
```
